name: Osric Strang
summary: In Stormwind's Old Town, veteran armor merchant Osric Strang supplies weary travelers and Alliance defenders with sturdy gear. His shop, Limited Immunity, offers heavy mail and plate armor, along with shields.

sections.title: Shopkeeper of Limited Immunity
sections.body: Osric Strang runs Limited Immunity, where fighters can find heavy armor and shields. He also helps couriers arriving from nearby settlements, including Sentinel Hill in Westfall, by giving them a point of contact in the capital.

faq.answer: Osric sells heavy protective armor, including augmented chain, polished scale, solid platemail suits, bucklers, and heater shields.

faq.q: Where can I find Osric Strang?
faq.answer: You can find Osric inside Limited Immunity, an armor shop in Old Town near Stormwind's southern district.

faq.q: Why am I sent to Osric Strang on a quest?
faq.answer: Couriers carrying goods across the kingdom, including shipments arriving by gryphon master from Westfall, deliver them to Osric's shop in Old Town and receive return messages.

angles.text: As a warrior visiting Old Town, you can find reliable chain, scale, plate, and shields from Osric for dependable bulk protection.
As an Alliance member, you can rely on Stormwind resident Osric to equip the kingdom's defenders and help couriers maintain supply links between Stormwind and outlying settlements.
